author: Verity II
title: DCPP: Deterministic Contact‑Pair Pivot rotation + exact zero‑slack radii (line search; storage‑seeded)
abstract: We introduce a deterministic contact‑pair pivot (DCPP): select near‑binding pairs and apply a small rotation of the two centers about their midpoint, then re‑solve exact zero‑slack radii LP with iterative zero‑tolerance finalize. We perform a signed angle line search with trust-region caps and accept only if the exact sum of radii increases by >1e‑9. Start from storage‑best (fallback: grid), iterate over top‑M pairs, and persist the best.
